papers.title: Strengthening mechanisms and tensile behavior of onion-like carbon reinforced 316L stainless steel fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究SLM成形316L不锈钢的拉伸强化机制，与增材制造生物医学材料方向相关，但未涉及植入体多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: It reports tensile strengthening of SLM 316L with onion-like carbon but does not address porous implant structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索碳纳米材料增强SLM成形316L不锈钢力学性能的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备洋葱状碳增强316L复合材料并开展拉伸测试与组织表征。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了洋葱状碳对316L的强化机制及其对拉伸性能的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸力学测试结合显微组织表征进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study explores whether onion-like carbon can reinforce 316L stainless steel produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Onion-like carbon reinforced 316L composites were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized through tensile testing and microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: The strengthening mechanisms induced by onion-like carbon and their influence on tensile behavior are elucidated.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical tensile testing combined with microstructural characterization.

papers.title: Preoperative Factors Associated With Pulmonary Embolism Following Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty: An ACS-NSQIP Analysis of 2017–2021 Data
papers.abstract: Background This study examined preoperative factors associated with 30-day pulmonary embolism (PE) after primary total hip arthroplasty. Methods ACS-NSQIP records from 2017–2021 with CPT code 27130 were analyzed. Complete cases were included using cleaned body mass index (BMI), age, sex, steroid use, and disseminated cancer. These five variables were entered jointly into logistic regression. Results Among 196,495 complete cases, 484 (0.246%) had PE. Adjusted odds ratios were 6.44 for disseminated cancer, 1.69 for steroid use, 1.23 for female sex, 1.041 per year of age, and 1.031 per kg/m² of BMI (all P < .05). Apparent AUC was 0.647 (95% CI, 0.622–0.672). The Hosmer–Lemeshow test indicated lack of fit (P = .012). Conclusions Five preoperative characteristics were associated with PE. Discrimination was modest, calibration limitations were present, and validation is required before clinical use.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文仅分析全髋置换术后肺栓塞的术前临床危险因素，与股骨柄生物力学、应力遮挡或界面微动无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a clinical NSQIP registry study of pulmonary embolism risk factors with no biomechanical modeling, no femoral stem stress shielding, no micromotion or contact mechanics, and no FEA boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 识别初次全髋置换术后30天肺栓塞的术前危险因素。
summary_zh.method: 基于2017–2021年ACS-NSQIP数据库，对196,495例完整病例做多因素logistic回归。
summary_zh.result: 播散性肿瘤、激素使用、女性、年龄和BMI与肺栓塞风险升高相关，但模型区分度仅AUC 0.647。
summary_zh.validation: 使用大样本临床注册数据回顾性分析，未做外部验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study sought to identify preoperative characteristics associated with 30-day pulmonary embolism after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A multivariable logistic regression was fitted to 196,495 complete ACS-NSQIP records (2017–2021, CPT 27130) using five preoperative variables.
summary_en.result: Disseminated cancer, steroid use, female sex, age, and BMI were associated with elevated PE odds, although discrimination was modest (AUC 0.647) and calibration was inadequate.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective analysis of a large national clinical registry without external validation.

papers.title: STEAM and Computational Thinking in Technology-Enhanced Education: A Systematic Review of Learning Design
papers.abstract: This systematic literature review examines how STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics) and computational thinking (CT) activities are conceptualized and implemented in technology-enhanced learning environments in primary and lower secondary education. Guided by PRISMA 2020 procedures, 34 empirical studies were analyzed using inductive content analysis to identify recurring pedagogical structures. Seven categories emerged: problem-based, inquiry-based, and project-based pedagogical forms; a social dimension of collaborative learning; and modal formats including role-playing, game-based, and experiential learning. These categories reflect patterns of pedagogical organization rather than disciplinary content alone. Interpreted through the lens of active learning, the findings indicate that STEAM and CT activities are predominantly structured as activity-centered, interdisciplinary, and iterative learning processes. CT appears not as an isolated technological skill but as a structuring principle for organizing reasoning, problem decomposition, and solution refinement across subject domains. Overall, the reviewed studies suggest that STEAM–CT integration increasingly functions as a model of learning design and orchestration: CT organizes sequences of cognitive actions, while active learning formats cultivate epistemic practices (investigating, designing, testing, and refining) realized through the interaction of tools, artifacts, and collaborative structures. This positioning highlights STEAM and CT as integral to contemporary science, mathematics, and technology education.
papers.venue: International Journal of Technology in Education

summary_zh.validation: 系统综述，无实验或数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: The review aims to clarify how STEAM and computational thinking are conceptualized and enacted in technology-enhanced primary and secondary education.
summary_en.method: Following PRISMA 2020, 34 empirical studies were synthesized through inductive content analysis to derive recurring pedagogical structures.
summary_en.result: Seven pedagogical categories emerged, with computational thinking framed as a structuring principle for reasoning and problem decomposition rather than an isolated skill.
summary_en.validation: As a systematic literature review, it relies on qualitative synthesis of prior empirical studies without experimental or numerical validation.

papers.title: Coupling Multi-Temporal Satellite InSAR Ground Subsidence and Extreme Value Theory Rainfall Modeling for Urban Flood Vulnerability in Greater Accra, Ghana
papers.abstract: Urban flash flood vulnerability assessments conventionally treat digital elevation models (DEMs) as temporally static surfaces. However, rapidly urbanizing coastal metropolises across the Global South frequently experience substantial, ongoing land subsidence that alters surface hydraulic gradients over decadal baselines. This study presents an integrated computational framework coupling multi-temporal Synthetic Aperture Radar interferometry (InSAR), statistical Extreme Value Theory (EVT), and physics-informed machine learning to quantify flood inundation across Greater Accra, Ghana. Daily precipitation records (1990 to 2024; 12,784 observations calibrated via CHIRPS/ERA5) were analyzed using Peaks-Over-Threshold (POT) sampling with a Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) fitted via Maximum Likelihood Estimation, establishing 5, 10, 25, 50, and 100-year design rainstorms. Multi-temporal Sentinel-1 C-band radar displacement fields (calibrated with multi-frequency NISAR interfaces) were decomposed into vertical subsidence rates, revealing three distinct kinematic subsidence bowls with peak downward velocities reaching -35.0 mm/year centered over the Odaw River Basin, Kwame Nkrumah Circle, Weija, and Glefe. A Dynamic Hydraulic Inundation Index (DHII) was formulated and modeled using an ensemble HistGradientBoosting classifier alongside a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) enforcing 2D Saint-Venant shallow water continuity. The machine learning architecture achieved strong rare-event discrimination (AUC-PR = 0.9596, Matthews Correlation Coefficient = 0.8341, accuracy = 90.75%), while the PINN converged to a shallow water PDE residual of 0.000204, predicting a 1.69 m inundation depth at Kwame Nkrumah Circle during a 50-year storm, aligning with municipal survey marks. Results demonstrate that differential ground subsidence systematically flattens natural drainage gradients, transforming ordinary corridors into hydraulic flood traps. Open-Source Code Repository: https://github.com/eminent337/accra-insar-extreme-rainfall Keywords: InSAR, Extreme Value Theory, Generalized Pareto Distribution, Ground Subsidence, Flash Flooding, Physics-Informed Neural Networks, Accra Ghana, Open-Source Geosciences.

summary_en.motivation: Conventional urban flood vulnerability assessments assume static terrain, overlooking ongoing subsidence that reshapes hydraulic gradients over decades.
summary_en.method: The study couples multi-temporal Sentinel-1 InSAR subsidence fields, peaks-over-threshold extreme value rainfall modeling, and a physics-informed neural network enforcing shallow-water continuity, alongside a gradient-boosting inundation classifier.
summary_en.result: The framework attains strong rare-event discrimination (AUC-PR 0.96) and predicts a 1.69 m inundation depth at a central Accra site under a 50-year storm, consistent with municipal survey marks.
summary_en.validation: Validation relies on comparison with municipal survey marks and PDE residual convergence rather than physical experiments.

papers.title: Vitamin C-Induced Photo-Redox Threshold Enables High-Fidelity Volumetric Printing of Collagen.
papers.abstract: Tomographic volumetric printing (TVP) enables rapid fabrication of complex, centimeter-scale 3D architectures. TVP of native proteins such as collagen is attractive because it preserves native bioactive motifs that regulate cell-matrix signaling. However, direct TVP of collagen remains challenging because dityrosine crosslinking, driven by visible-light-activated Ru(II)bpy3 2+/sodium persulfate (SPS), lacks an effective inhibitory mechanism. This results in near-immediate crosslinking upon light exposure, leading to an insufficient nonlinear threshold response that fails to suppress background curing. Here, we introduce vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid) as a biocompatible redox regulator to overcome this limitation. We demonstrated that vitamin C established a photo-redox threshold by suppressing Ru(III) accumulation and scavenging persulfate radicals within the Ru/SPS system, thereby delaying dityrosine crosslinking until vitamin C depletion. This threshold generated the nonlinear response required for TVP, enabling high-fidelity volumetric printing of collagen. Post-printing construct densification (∼53% shrinkage) further improved feature resolution (80 µm positive; 120 µm negative) and yielded mechanically stable and highly stretchable hydrogels (up to 180% strain). Collagen resin with vitamin C supported both cell seeding post-printing and cell-laden printing with high cell density and viability, enabling the rapid biofabrication of cell-instructive 3D microenvironments.

papers.title: Curcumin-loaded alkali-heat-treated titanium modulates macrophage inflammatory responses.
papers.abstract: Chronic inflammation at the implant-tissue interface is a major contributor to implant failure. Therefore, enhancing the biological response of titanium (Ti) surfaces is critical for promoting early osseointegration and improving long-term implant stability. In this study, alkali-heat-treated (AHT) Ti was evaluated as a platform for the controlled delivery of curcumin (Cur), a natural anti-inflammatory compound. The release kinetics of curcumin and the interactions between curcumin-loaded AHT Ti surfaces and RAW264.7 macrophages were investigated in vitro. Various polymer coating strategies were applied to modulate curcumin release. The presence of poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) reduced the curcumin release under both physiological (pH 7.4) and acidic (pH 5.0) conditions, with uncoated AHT samples exhibiting the greatest cumulative release (∼21.3 μg) in Study 1. Increasing the loaded curcumin amount from 100 to 300 μg resulted in a decrease in the release for both pH 7.4 and pH 5.0, whereas the incorporation of polyethylene glycol/polycaprolactone (PEG/PCL) coating enhanced the gradual curcumin release (Study 2). Increasing the curcumin loading from 50 to 100 and 300 μg increased the total amount of curcumin released, with the 300 μg group exhibiting a more gradual release profile. However, the percentage of curcumin released decreased as the loading amount increased (Study 3). When macrophages were cultured on Ti surfaces, AHT samples exhibited higher cell viability than polished (P) control samples, and the presence of curcumin reduced cell viability in a dose-dependent manner. While macrophages cultured on AHT surfaces exhibited a transient increase in pro-inflammatory marker expression at 24 h compared with polished surfaces, the expression of these markers was reduced by 48 h. Notably, curcumin significantly decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression at both the gene and protein levels and suppressed NF-κB activation in macrophages exposed to inflammatory stimuli. Overall, the sustained and controlled release of curcumin from AHT Ti surface is highly dependent on the curcumin loading amount as well as the presence and composition of the polymer coating. Moreover, both AHT and curcumin significantly reduced inflammatory responses in macrophages, demonstrating the potential of the curcumin-loaded AHT Ti platform as an immunomodulatory surface for improving the biological performance and long-term success of Ti implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文聚焦钛表面碱热处理与姜黄素缓释调控巨噬细胞炎症，属于植入体表面免疫调控，与增材制造多孔结构、力学性能或应力遮挡无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports no LPBF/AM fabrication, no porous structure design, no mechanical or fatigue testing, and no stiffness-matching or stress-shielding analysis; it is purely a surface drug-release and in vitro immunology study.

summary_zh.motivation: 植入体界面慢性炎症导致失效，需改善钛表面早期骨整合与长期稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 对钛进行碱热处理并负载姜黄素，用PLGA或PEG/PCL涂层调控释放，与RAW264.7巨噬细胞共培养。
summary_zh.result: 释放量受载药量与涂层组成影响，姜黄素显著降低促炎因子并抑制NF-κB活化。
summary_zh.validation: 体外释放动力学测试与巨噬细胞活力、基因及蛋白水平炎症标志物检测。

summary_en.motivation: Chronic inflammation at the implant-tissue interface compromises long-term fixation, motivating immunomodulatory titanium surfaces that support early osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Alkali-heat-treated titanium was loaded with curcumin and coated with PLGA or PEG/PCL to tune release, then co-cultured with RAW264.7 macrophages under physiological and acidic conditions.
summary_en.result: Curcumin release depended on loading dose and coating composition, and curcumin suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine expression and NF-κB activation while AHT surfaces maintained higher macrophage viability.
summary_en.validation: In vitro release kinetics assays combined with macrophage viability, gene/protein inflammatory marker quantification, and NF-κB activation assessment.
